### Instruction:

seq2sid.instruction: Can you predict the next possible item that the user may expect?
seq2sid.input: The user has interacted with items {hist} in chronological order. Can you predict the next possible item that the user may expect?

sid2title.instruction: Answer the question about item identification.
sid2title.input: What is the title of item "{sid}"?

title2sid.instruction: Answer the question about item identification.

seq2title.instruction: Can you recommend the next item for the user based on their interaction history?
seq2title.input: The user has sequentially interacted with items {hist}. Can you recommend the next item for him? Tell me the title of the item
